system.description:
Growing Unique (rapier +1).

Dormant (when found, save DC 13): you climb as a spider.

Awakened (bearer 9th level, save DC 15): the rapier is +2; it deals +1d6 poison on a hit.

Exalted (bearer 17th level, save DC 17): the rapier is +3; once per day, cast web, and you move freely through webs.

Monsters & Treasure, Growing Uniques. Each state adds to the one before. It falls back to Dormant with a new bearer. Its bonus is +1 Dormant, +2 Awakened and +3 Exalted: raise it on the item when it wakes.
